name: Solid FEM
panel.honest: Falanqeyn dhig-jilicsan ama modal oo qaybtan ah, oo leh maktabadda CadCraft ee finite element (tetrahedra quadratic). Dhaqdhaqaaq yar, agab walxo isku-jihayn linear-elastic ah; ma jiro is-taabsi, ma jiro gogol. Waa caawin falanqeed injineer, ma aha ansixin naqshad.
mat.label: Agab
support.fixed: Go'an: saddexda jihood oo dhan ayaa la xannaaneeyaa
load.pressure_mpa: Cadaadis (MPa, togan wuxuu gudaha u riixayaa)
mesh.info: {n} tetrahedra quadratic, {nodes} dhibcood, {dofs} aan la garanayn, cabbirka {h} mm
kind.label: Baaritaan
res.maxvm_raw: von Mises ugu weyn (aan la siman)
plot.none: Wax jaantus ah weli ma jiraan: marka hore xallii.
plot.too_big: Jaantuskani wuxuu u baahan yahay {n} saddex-geesood; xadku waa 60000. Isticmaal mesh ka qallafsan.
plot.shown: Jaantuska waa la dhigay moodeelka ({n} xarago midab, isbeddel x{scale}). Buluugga waa qiimaha ugu hooseeya, casaanka ugu sarreeya.
plot.range: {name}: {lo} ilaa {hi} {unit}; isbeddelka x{scale} ayaa la sawiray.
plot.stale: Dejintu way beddeshay ka dib markii jaantuska la dhigay; wuxuu muujinayaa natiijadii hore. Mar kale xallii oo jaantus cusub dhig.
msg.pick: Riix wejiyada qaybta ku jira muuqaalka 3D si aad ugu darto {id}, mar kale riix si aad mid uga saarto. Marka aad dhammayso riix Dhammee doorashada.
msg.no_faces: Qaybtan ma leh wejiyo magac loo bixiyay oo la dooran karo (isticmaal kernel-ka mesh-ka ama kernel-ka saxda ah).
msg.max_faces: Shay hal mid ah ugu badnaan 64 wejiyo.
msg.no_part: Ma jiro qayb geed oo mesh loo samayn karo. Marka hore samee qaybta.
msg.too_fine: Cabbir yar oo sidaas ah waxay samayn doontaa qiyaastii {n} elementiyo; xadka bogga waa {max}. Isticmaal cabbir weyn, ama orod moodeel weyn workstation-ka.
msg.meshed: Mesh waa la sameeyay: {n} elementiyo, {nodes} dhibcood.
msg.mesh_big: Mesh-ku wuxuu leeyahay {n} elementiyo; xadka bogga waa {max}. Isticmaal cabbir element oo weyn.
msg.done: La xisaabiyay: kala-guurka ugu weyn {d} mm, von Mises ugu weyn {s} MPa.
msg.done_modal: La xalliyay: inta jeer ee dabiiciga ah ee ugu horreysa {f} Hz.
msg.stale: Qaybtii way beddeshay. Mesh oo mar kale xallii.
undo.support_add: Solid FEM: ku dar wejiyada go'an
undo.load_edit: Solid FEM: wax ka beddel culeyska
undo.show: Solid FEM: jaantus moodeelka ku dhex yaal
note.liability: Ma aha hubinta xeerka; injineerkaaga ayaa dib u eegi doona natiijooyinka.
note.limits: Dhig-jilicsan, dhaqdhaqaaq yar, agab isku-jihayn. Cadaadiska meelaha taageerada, meelaha culeyska iyo geesaha jilicsan wuxuu ku xirnaan doonaa mesh-ka. Tirooyinku waa kuwa maktabaddan, ma aha kuwa barnaamij kale oo kasta.
w.too_many: {n} elementiyo ayaa ka badan inta bogga xallin karo ({max}). Isticmaal cabbir element oo weyn, ama orod moodeel weyn workstation-ka.
w.bad_elements: {n} elementiyo mugooda waa eber ama mid taban. Mesh mar kale oo cabbir element kale isticmaal.
w.support_no_faces: Taageerada {id} ma leh wejiyo mesh-ka ku jira. Wejiyadeeda mar kale dooro.
w.no_support: Waxba ma hayo qaybta. Ku dar wejiyada go'an.
w.under_held: Qaybta lama hayo: {n} ka mid ah lixda dhaqdhaqaaqa jidka adag ayaa weli xor ah. Ku dar wejiyada go'an si aanay u dhaqdhaqmin ama u wareegin.
w.load_no_faces: Culeyska {id} ma leh wejiyo mesh-ka ku jira. Wejiyadeeda mar kale dooro.
w.faces_gone: {id}: qaar ka mid ah wejiyadeeda ma ku jiraan qaybta mar hore waana laga reebay.
w.no_load: Ma jiro culeys: natiijadu waa eber.
w.gravity_no_density: Cufnaanta miisaanku waxay u baahan tahay cufnaan; agabkan ma leh, markaa culeys ma ku darto.
w.modal_no_density: Inta jeer ee dabiiciga ah waxay u baahan tahay cufnaan.
w.modal_not_converged: Raadinta inta jeer si buuxda uma isku ag dhowaan; qaababka sare si taxaddar leh u eeg.
w.not_converged: Xalliyuhu isma uu dhowaan (hadhaaga {res}). Natiijooyinka ma aha kuwo la isku halayn karo.
w.unbalanced: Falcelinta taageerada ma isku dheelitirmaan culeyska (farqiga xiriirka {rel}). Natiijooyinka ha isku halayn.
w.coarse: Kaliya {n} elementiyo: mesh qallafsan. Hagaaji (cabbir element yar) oo barbar dhig ka hor intaadan isku halayn walaaca.
w.large_disp: Barashada ugu weyn waa {pct}% cabbirka qaybta. Baaritaankani wuxuu male-awaan yahay barashada yar; natiijadu ma aha mid la isku halayn karo.
w.over_yield: Walaaca ugu weyn ({vm} MPa) wuu ka sarreeyaa xadka dhalaalka ({y} MPa). Baaritaanka jilicsan ma raacin karo agabka ka dib dhalaalka; walaaca la muujiyay ma aha mid run ah.
w.stress_spread: Walaaca aan la siman ee dhibcaha elementiyada ({raw} MPa) aad buu uga sarreeyaa celceliska dhibcaha ({avg} MPa): dhabarku waa cidhiidhi ama mesh-ku meeshaas waa qallafsan yahay. Hagaaji oo barbar dhig.
w.singular: Walaaca meelaha taageerada, meelaha culeyska iyo geesaha jilicsan wuu kordhaa marka mesh-ka la hagaajiyo; si taxaddar leh u akhri.
